0022600226.text: The Trail Blazers (7-3, 3rd in the Northwest, 8th in the West) host the Oklahoma City Thunder (8-3, 2nd in the Northwest, 6th in the West) in Portland's 11th game of the season, with Portland on a one-game win streak and Oklahoma City coming off a loss. Portland is missing Ja Morant (hamstring), Shaedon Sharpe (knee, surgery), and Vit Krejci (ankle), while Oklahoma City is without Cason Wallace (shoulder, surgery), Chet Holmgren (knee), Jalen Williams (leg, fracture), Jaylin Williams (back, spasms), and Thomas Sorber (knee). The Trail Blazers lead the 2026-27 season series 1-0 after a 123-103 win in Portland in their last meeting, and they lost the 2025-26 series 1-3.
